currentStatus: DevOps Bootcamp Complete — Batch 07 🎓 (ISO certification incoming)

entries.title: Linux Foundations
entries.description: Completed Linux basics — file system navigation, permissions, process management, sudo, package management, and working confidently in the terminal.

entries.title: Git & GitHub
entries.description: Covered full Git workflow — version control, branching, merging, conflict resolution, collaborating on GitHub, pull requests, and deploying live projects with GitHub Pages.

entries.title: Servers, APIs & Application Architecture
entries.description: Deep dive into servers, REST APIs, monolithic vs microservices architecture, multi-tier web application architecture, proxy servers, load balancing, and reverse proxies.

entries.title: Cloud Computing & AWS Fundamentals
entries.description: Learned IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, cloud deployment models, and AWS fundamentals. Set up AWS account, explored the management console, and practiced free tier best practices.

entries.title: AWS IAM & EC2
entries.description: Covered IAM users, groups, policies, and roles with hands-on configuration. Set up EC2 instances, connected via SSH, configured security groups, and assigned IAM roles.

entries.title: AWS Storage, Load Balancing & VPC
entries.description: Learned S3 storage, bucket policies, static site hosting, ELB/ALB load balancers, auto scaling groups, VPC setup, subnets, route tables, gateways, and VPC peering.

entries.title: AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch & CloudFormation
entries.description: Covered serverless computing with Lambda, SQS and SNS integrations, CloudWatch monitoring and alarms, CloudTrail logging, and Infrastructure as Code with CloudFormation templates.

entries.title: Docker & Containerization
entries.description: Learned Docker architecture, writing Dockerfiles, building images, running containers, volumes, networks, Docker Compose for multi-container apps, and multi-stage builds.

entries.title: CI/CD with Jenkins
entries.description: Built full CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins — freestyle and declarative pipeline jobs, GitHub webhook integration, SonarQube for code quality, Docker-Jenkins integration, and Blue Ocean.

entries.title: Maven & Advanced Jenkins
entries.description: Covered Maven build lifecycle and Jenkins integration, Jenkins master-slave configuration on AWS EC2, role-based access control, and backup and restore strategies.

entries.title: Shell Scripting & Cron Jobs
entries.description: Built practical shell scripts — variables, conditionals, loops, functions, error handling, DevOps automation use cases like log monitoring, disk usage alerts, and backup scripts with cron scheduling.

entries.title: Monitoring with Prometheus & Grafana
entries.description: Set up Prometheus and Node Exporter on AWS EC2, integrated with Grafana, created monitoring dashboards, configured alerts, and followed best practices for DevOps observability.

entries.title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
entries.description: Covered Kubernetes architecture, pods, ReplicaSets, deployments, services (NodePort, ClusterIP, LoadBalancer), YAML configuration, networking, and deployed a microservices voting app on K8s.

entries.title: Kubernetes on Cloud — EKS, GKE & AKS
entries.description: Completed managed Kubernetes on cloud providers — AWS EKS, Google GKE, and Azure AKS. Final week of the Error Makes Clever DevOps Bootcamp.

entries.title: DevSecOps Beyond the Basics
entries.description: Completed the Advanced Add-On module covering SAST, SCA, DAST, Trivy installation and container vulnerability scanning, and DevSecOps best practices.
